registry_source_of_truth: MASTERSCHEMA.md tool table → agent/tool_registry.json via update.py (J-08, never hand-edited)
mcp_rule: mcp_server.py:27-38 read_tools() publishes ONLY side_effect==false; build_server() asserts no side-effect/approval tool is published (mcp_server.py:54-56)

tools.name: search_policy
tools.purpose: search policy wiki/runbooks; tenant+clearance scoped; returns citable chunk ids

tools.name: lookup_employee
tools.purpose: directory record (name, dept, manager, schedule); tenant-scoped

tools.name: recall_memory
tools.purpose: recall long-term facts about this employee

tools.name: reset_access
tools.purpose: reset an employee's access grant (clears lockouts, re-issues SSO)
tools.gated_by: authz (self-only unless admin, D-033/D-042/D-045) + approval (HITL, D-004/D-034)

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.signature: create_ticket(queue: str, summary: str, priority: str = 'P3') -> str

tools.name: remember
tools.purpose: persist a durable fact to long-term memory
tools.gated_by: approval (HITL) — memory writes are side effects (D-018)

tools.name: escalate_to_human
tools.purpose: hand off to a human operator (out-of-policy / low confidence)
